rule.name: IntProductWidenedLate
rule.message: This int multiplication is computed in 32 bits and only then added to or multiplied with a long, so it overflows silently before the widening (timeToLive * 1000 wraps once timeToLive passes about 2.1 million). Make a factor long first: System.currentTimeMillis() + timeToLive * 1000L, (long) hour * 60, or convert with TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMillis(timeToLive) or Math.multiplyExact. Constant products pass, and so do products with a byte, short or char factor, a small literal factor (16 or less) next to a plain variable, a loop variable factor, an array length factor and products that contain a method call. A shift by 16 or more is reported the same way: base + (steps << 20).

property.name: xpath
property.value: //InfixExpression[@Operator = ('*', '<<')][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('int')] [not(@CompileTimeConstant = true())] [every $operand in * satisfies $operand[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('int') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Integer')]] [not(@Operator = '<<' and *[2]/self::NumericLiteral[@ValueAsInt < 16])] [empty(.//MethodCall) and empty(.//FieldAccess[@Name = 'length'])] [not(@Operator = '*' and (some $i in (1, 2) satisfies *[$i]/self::NumericLiteral[@ValueAsInt <= 16] and *[3 - $i][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess or self::ArrayAccess]))] [empty(.//VariableAccess[@Name = (ancestor::ForStatement/ForInit//VariableId/@Name, ancestor::ForeachStatement/LocalVariableDeclaration//VariableId/@Name)])] [not(exists(.//VariableAccess) and empty(.//FieldAccess | .//ArrayAccess) and (every $v in .//VariableAccess satisfies $v/@CompileTimeConstant = true() or exists($v/ancestor::Block//LocalVariableDeclaration[pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final'] /VariableDeclarator[VariableId/@Name = $v/@Name][NumericLiteral])))] [let $parent := ancestor::*[not(self::ParenthesizedExpression or self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('+', '-', '*')][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('int')])][1] return exists($parent/self::InfixExpression[@Operator = ('+', '-', '*')][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('long')]) and empty(ancestor::InfixExpression[@Operator = '*'][pmd-java:typeIsExactly('int')][. >> $parent])]
